subject: Switching demo to POC scoping — availability and attendees
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo for Redwood — proposed times

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time on the call last week. We'd love to do a short product intro for the Acme team to show how Redwood could slot into your inference stack. Two quick windows that work on our side:

- Thu, May 7 — 11:00am PT (30 mins)
- Mon, May 10 — 9:00am PT (30 mins)

If neither works, tell me a couple slots that do and we’ll pivot. I’ll invite our SE (Marissa) so she can demo live and answer architecture questions.

Agenda (short intro):
- 10m: high-level platform overview
- 15m: demo focused on production serving (latency/cost controls)
- 5m: next steps / possible deep dive

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: meeting-options.ics (stub)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@acme.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Redwood — proposed times

Connor —

Appreciate you reaching out. Quick heads-up: I’ll be traveling the week of May 7 and won’t be back until the 12th. Tom (cc'd) will be with the team, but we were actually hoping to do a deeper technical session rather than a high-level intro — our infra and ML engineers want to cover deployment patterns, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and POC scope.

Can we switch this to a technical deep dive / POC scoping call the week of May 13? Preferably 60–90 mins and with your SEs / SRE folks included. Ideal times for our side: May 13 morning PT or May 14 afternoon PT.

Also please include an agenda and any pre-call questions so the engineers can prep.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Head of ML Platform, Acme AI

--
Note: Tom and I will need a short NDAs if you plan to share architecture specifics (we can sign a mutual NDA).

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.ai>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Redwood — proposed times

Thanks for the context, Sarah — that makes total sense. Happy to pivot to a POC scoping session. I've looped in Aditya (Solutions Engineer) and Marissa (Sales Engineer) so we have both architecture and deployment expertise on the call.

Proposed slots (60–90 mins):
- Thu, May 13 — 10:00am PT
- Fri, May 14 — 4:00pm PT

I attached a short POC scoping template and a proposed agenda so your team can see what we typically cover. If you’re comfortable with mutual NDA, I’ll send a one-click DocuSign link after we lock time.

Proposed agenda (draft):
- 10m: Introductions & success criteria for POC
- 20–30m: Current infra + data flow review (Acme engineers)
- 20–30m: Redwood demo focusing on deployment options, KV/prefix caching, and quantization tradeoffs
- 10–20m: POC scope, responsibilities, timeline, and success metrics

Attachments: poc-scoping-template.docx, redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo for Redwood — proposed times

Hi Sarah —

Happy to join the scoping session. May 13 at 10:00am PT works for me. A couple quick asks so we can tailor the demo:

- Can you share the current inference stack (model sizes, preferred frameworks, on-prem vs cloud)?
- Expected peak qps and latency targets for the POC
- Any constraints around data residency / VPC access

I also attached a short pre-call questionnaire that helps us plan lab access and sandbox requirements. If you want, Aditya and I can prepare two short example configs (one cloud-hosted, one private) to compare expected token cost and latency.

Marissa Cole
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
